summary.text: Nick Santucci is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 64 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. His background is in government affairs and workforce development.

paragraphs.text: Santucci lives in Howland Township, Ohio, and earned a B.A. in political science and philosophy from John Carroll University in 2013.

He worked as manager of education and workforce development and as director of government and public affairs for the Youngstown/Warren Regional Chamber, and as director of government affairs and workforce development at the Education Service Center of Eastern Ohio.
Santucci won the District 64 seat in 2022 by defeating Vince Peterson II and was re-elected in 2024 over Lauren Mathews.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Development, Finance, Workforce and Higher Education, Rules and Reference, and Ways and Means committees.
